attributes.description: The biological species of the animal.

attributes.name: vocal_ability
attributes.description: Description of the animal's linguistic proficiency and tone.

attributes.name: discovery_context
attributes.description: The circumstances and location where the animal was first found.

entity_types.description: Researchers and academics specializing in biology, linguistics, or cognitive sciences.

attributes.description: The specific branch of science the individual practices.

attributes.name: academic_rank
attributes.description: The professional standing of the scientist.

attributes.name: lab_affiliation

entity_types.name: Journalist

attributes.name: press_outlet

attributes.name: professional_status

entity_types.name: Activist
entity_types.description: Individuals advocating for animal rights, ethical treatment, or legal personhood.

attributes.name: organization_link
attributes.description: The specific NGO or movement they are associated with.

attributes.name: influence_level

attributes.name: spiritual_title

attributes.name: doctrine_stance

entity_types.name: GovernmentOfficial

attributes.name: office_title

attributes.name: jurisdiction_scope
